Testone: style showcase

This user story is a pounce live test. It exercises every kind of formatting the editor supports, so the read-back can be compared.

Inline styles

Bold, italic, underlined, strikethrough, all three together, inline code, H2O and E = mc2.

Red text, green text, highlighted text and bigger text.

Special characters: é à ü ñ ç ß — “quotes” & ampersand, <angle brackets>, 50% off, € 12,50, emoji 🦊 🚀.
